name: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars
description: The most celebrated competitors from RuPaul's Drag Race vie for a second chance to enter Drag Race herstory. This drag queen showdown is filled with plenty of heated competition, lip-syncing for the legacy, and, of course, the All-Stars Snatch Game.

videos.title: It Takes Two
videos.overview: In the season premiere, the queens have to produce high fashion editorial photo spreads.

videos.title: RuPaul's Gaff-In
videos.overview: The Queens go full camp to prove that there's more to being a drag superstar than simply relying on that body.

videos.title: Queens Behaving Badly
videos.overview: The queens hit the streets of Hollywood to prank unsuspecting passers-by. RuPaul's extra special guest judges are funny lady Rachel Dratch and the world's first supermodel, Janice Dickinson.

videos.title: All Star Girl Groups
videos.overview: Legendary children Kady Z, Jillian Hervey and Kelly Osbourne join the queens to form All Star girl groups in a battle of the divas for the fiercest set.

videos.title: Dynamic Drag Duos
videos.overview: The final four assume super hero and super foe alter egos and go to epic heights to vanquish their nemesis.

videos.title: The Grand Finale
videos.overview: For the final challenge, RuPaul sends her All Stars on a junket that culminates with a stand-up routine at L.A.’s Comedy Store.

videos.title: All Star Talent Show Extravaganza
videos.overview: Ten Queens return to compete for $100,000 and a place in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. The first test is to compete in a drag talent show. With guest judge Raven-Symoné.

videos.title: All Stars Snatch Game
videos.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show and burn rubber in a latex runway. With guest judge Ross Mathews.

videos.title: HERstory Of The World
videos.overview: The queens are challenged to perform in a lip-syncing dance number inspired by the legendary historical women. Fashion designer Jeremy Scott guest judges.

videos.title: Drag Movie Shequels
videos.overview: The queens acting chops are tested in parody movie sequels of RuPaul's favorite movies. Pussycat Doll Nicole Scherzinger guest judges.

videos.title: Revenge of the Queens
videos.overview: The queens must perform a live stand-up comedy act in front of an audience of judgmental drag queens. Ross Mathews returns to guest judge.

videos.title: Drag Fish Tank
videos.overview: The queens design and market drag-influenced products. Entrepreneur Marcus Lemonis (CNBC's The Profit) co-stars, and comedian Graham Norton guest judges.

videos.title: Family That Drags Together
videos.overview: The queens makeover family members; actress Aubrey Plaza judges

videos.title: All Stars Supergroup
videos.overview: The queens must write original rap lyrics and perform as a girl group; crowning a winner.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: The All Star queens reunite to dish about the most shocking, glamorous and sickening moments of the season. Hosted by the Emmy Award winning RuPaul.

videos.title: All-Star Variety Show
videos.overview: A mystery 10th queen joins the nine All Stars competing for $100,000 and a place in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. The first test is to compete in a drag variety show.

videos.title: Divas Lip Sync Live
videos.overview: The queens go full diva in a lip-syncing dance number inspired by the classic TV specials "VH1 Divas Live". With guest judge Vanessa Williams and choreographer Todrick Hall.

videos.title: The B*tchelor
videos.overview: The queens' improvisation skills are tested in an unscripted dating show. Constance Zimmer and Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman guest judge.

videos.title: All Stars Snatch Game
videos.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show. Fashion designer Marc Jacobs stops by the workroom, while Kristin Chenoweth and Nicole Byer (Girl Code) guest judge.

videos.title: Pop Art Ball
videos.overview: The queens design wearable soup cans inspired by Andy Warhol, and create Studio 54 disco looks. Tituss Burgess and Shay Mitchell guest judge.

videos.title: Handmaids To Kitty Girls
videos.overview: The eliminated queens return to the competition for revenge. But first the queens must audition for RuPaul's new girl group, the Kitty Girls. Spice Girl Emma Bunton ("Baby Spice") and Adam Lambert guest judge.

videos.title: My Best Squirrelfriend's Dragsmaids Wedding Trip
videos.overview: The queens’ acting chops are tested in a girl comedy blockbuster scene. Democratic Leader Nancy Pelosi stops by the workroom, while Chris Colfer and Garcelle Beauvais guest judge.

videos.title: A Jury Of Their Queers
videos.overview: The queens must write and perform a rap on RuPaul’s new hit single and conquer a one-take choreography performance. But before a winner can be crowned, RuPaul invites the eliminated queens to weigh in.

videos.title: All Star Super Queen Variety Show
videos.overview: The Queens' first challenge is a salute to LGBTQ troops in an All Star-Spangled Variety Show; extra special guest judge Jenifer Lewis joins.

videos.title: Super Girl Groups, Henny
videos.overview: RuPaul's Drag Race Season 3 contestant Stacy Layne Matthews returns for a musical collaboration with the queens of All Stars Season 4.

videos.title: Snatch Game of Love
videos.overview: The queens try out their best celebrity impressions for a romantic take on Snatch Game, and guest judges Gus Kenworthy and Keiynan Lonsdale weigh in on the competition.

videos.title: Jersey Justice
videos.overview: The All Stars get into character as litigants on an unscripted courtroom parody with New Jersey Justice Michelle Visage, and Zoe Kravitz and Erica Ash sit in as guest judges.

videos.title: Roast In Peace
videos.overview: The All Stars put their stand-up comedy chops to the test in a eulogy-style Roast of Lady Bunny, and Cecily Strong and Yvette Nicole Brown guest-judge the competition.

videos.title: LaLaPaRuZa
videos.overview: The All Stars are in for a surprise when they discover that the eliminated queens have returned for a lip sync smackdown and the opportunity to re-enter the competition.

videos.title: Queens Of Clubs
videos.overview: The All Stars design their own nightclubs (complete with entertainment and VIP experiences), and Rita Ora and New York City nightlife promoter Susanne Bartsch guest judge.

videos.title: RuPaul's Best Judy's Race
videos.overview: The All Stars give their best friends drag queen makeovers and perform a Judy Garland tribute, and Frances Bean Cobain and Ellen Pompeo sit in on the judges' panel.

videos.title: Sex And The Kitty, Girl 3
videos.overview: The All Stars put their acting skills to the test in a "Sex and the City"-inspired mockumentary, and Felicity Huffman and Jason Wu sit in on the judges' panel.

videos.title: Super Queen Grand Finale
videos.overview: In the final challenge of the season, the remaining girls write superhero-inspired lyrics and perform original choreography for RuPaul's "Super Queen".

videos.title: All Star Variety Extravaganza
videos.overview: The Season 5 All Stars make their werkroom entrances, extra special guest judge Ricky Martin gives a lesson in bilingual shade, and a new elimination twist is Ruvealed.

videos.title: I’m In Love!
videos.overview: The All Stars perform girl-group songs about their celebrity crushes and strut the runway in Love the Skin You're In lewks, and Tessa Thompson and Madison Beer guest judge.

videos.title: Get A Room!
videos.overview: The All Stars design their own boutique hotel suite experiences and show off three-in-one lewks on the runway, and Nicole Byer and Martyn Lawrence Bullard guest judge.

videos.title: SheMZ
videos.overview: The All Stars improv their way through celebrity scandals on a TMZ-inspired tabloid reality series and then walk the runway in camo couture, and Sarah Hyland guest judges.

videos.title: Snatch Game of Love
videos.overview: Guest judges Tommy Dorfman and Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman join the All Stars for a dating-themed version of Snatch Game, and the category on the runway is Prom Queen Fantasy.

videos.title: The Charles Family Backyard Ball
videos.overview: For the barbecue-themed Charles Family Backyard Ball, the All Stars design runway lewks using materials that can be found in a yard, and Bebe Rexha guest judges.

videos.title: Stand-Up Smackdown
videos.overview: The All Stars perform stand-up sets for guest judges Sam Richardson and Jane Krakowski at RuPaul's Shady Shack, and the category on the runway is Freak Out.

videos.title: Clap Back!
videos.overview: Before the next All Star is inducted into the Drag Race Hall of Fame, the eliminated queens return, and the Top Three girls write and perform verses of RuPaul's "Clap Back!".

videos.title: All Star Variety Extravaganza
videos.overview: The Queens of All Stars 6 are back to compete for a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. To kick off the competition, the dolls showcase their best talents on the Main Stage. Plus, the iconic Miss Piggy pops by to prove that reading IS fundamental.

videos.title: The Blue Ball
videos.overview: The All Stars storm the runway in their bold and blue-tiful best - in the Blue Ball! Guest Judge Big Freedia helps decide whose design will earn a blue ribbon.

videos.title: Side Hustles
videos.overview: Even the best queen needs a side hustle, so the All Stars must create commercials to sell their services. Tia Mowry joins as guest judge.

videos.title: Halftime Headliners
videos.overview: Fireworks fly as the All Stars celebrate and impersonate their favorite divas in an epic halftime show. Jamal Sims whips the dolls into shape as guest choreographer and judge.

videos.title: Pink Table Talk
videos.overview: The All Stars serve up piping hot tea as hosts of an up close and personal talk show, Pink Table Talk. Guest Judge Aisha Tyler stops by to join the kiki.

videos.title: Ru-Merican Horror Story: Coven Girl
videos.overview: Who is the baddest witch of all? Find out as the All Stars showcase their acting chops in this spooky spoof. Superstar Angela Bassett offers bewitching advice, and Guest Judge Emma Roberts stops by to cast a spell of her own.

videos.title: Show Up Queen
videos.overview: Drag and activism come together as the All Stars record and perform an inspiring anthem: "Show Up Queen!" Designer extraordinaire Zaldy brings his eye for fashion to the judging panel.

videos.title: Snatch Game of Love
videos.overview: The All Stars serve up their best celebrity impressions in a dating show version of the Snatch Game. Who's getting lucky? Guest judges Fortune Feimster and Cheyenne Jackson search for their perfect snatch match; superstar designer Ms. Tina Knowles- Lawson joins on the mainstage.

videos.title: Drag Tots
videos.overview: The All Stars turn themselves into magical characters fit for the hit animated series, Drag Tots. Guest Judge Charli XCX stops by for this fierce foray into fantasy and fun.

videos.title: Rudemption Lip-Sync Smackdown
videos.overview: The eliminated queens are back to compete in an epic Lip Sync Smackdown and a chance to return to the competition.

videos.title: The Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve and Talent Monologues
videos.overview: The All Stars take the stage to share hilarious and heartwarming true stories in a performance challenge that decides who makes it to the Grand Finale! Actors Jermaine Fowler and Alec Mapa coach the queens; writer/director Justin Simien joins the judges’ panel.

videos.title: This Is Our Country
videos.overview: Who will take home the crown? A spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame is at stake as the finalists write, record, and perform verses to RuPaul's new song This is Our Country, featuring country music legend Tanya Tucker.

videos.title: Legends
videos.overview: Eight legendary RuPaul's Drag Race winners have returned to battle for the title of "Queen of All Queens." After a raucous reading challenge and an epic runway session with supermodel Naomi Campbell, our queens must put together a show-stopping performance of RuPaul's song "Legends." Special Guest Judge Cameron Diaz brings her star power to the Drag Race panel.

videos.title: Snatch Game
videos.overview: For the first time in Drag Race herstory, the crowned queens must perform two iconic celebrity impersonations in a Snatch Game Double-Header! International style icon Daphne Guiness joins the judges' panel.

videos.title: The Realness of Fortune Ball
videos.overview: The legendary queens put their spin on the classic Drag Race ball challenge, serving 3 looks each in the "Realness of Fortune" Ball. Vanna White is in the house to make sure things are letter-perfect, and actress Kirby Howell-Baptiste graces the judges' panel.

videos.title: Fairytale Justice
videos.overview: All rise! The legends are telling tall tales in court as they bring their best storybook characters to the witness stand in this twisted improv challenge. Drag Race veteran Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman is back to testify on the judges' panel.

videos.title: Draguation Speeches
videos.overview: The queens deliver inspiring and irreverent commencement speeches for draguates around the world. Nikki Glaser shares her comedic expertise and helps Mama Ru pick this week's Valedictorian.

videos.title: Total Ru-quest Live
videos.overview: The queens live out their Y2K girl group fantasies on a dragtastic tribute to TRL! And on the runway, category is: Night of 1,000 Dolly Partons. Pop star Tove Lo joins the judges' panel.

videos.title: Legendary Legend Looks
videos.overview: Fashion Icon and Supermodel of the World, Rupaul, challenges the crowned queens to use their divine design skills to transform eight of her legendary looks. Iconic and effervescent designer Betsey Johnson spices up the judges' panel.

videos.title: Santa's School for Girls
videos.overview: Ho ho ho! The queens make the yuletide gayer as they star in the twisted new holiday cult classic, "Santa's School for Girls." Acclaimed film director Janicza Bravo brings her expertise to set, and reviews the queens' performances on the judges panel.

videos.title: Dance Like a Drag Queen
videos.overview: The queens try to break the internet by creating an original dance video challenge. On the runway, category is: What Lies Beneath. Ben Platt lends his voice to the judges' panel.

videos.title: The Kennedy Davenport Center Honors Hall of Shade
videos.overview: The queens take the stage to roast each other at the first-ever Kennedy Davenport Center "Hall of Shade" Honors. Pulitzer prize-winning journalist, Ronan Farrow, joins the esteemed judges' panel.

videos.title: Drag Race Gives Back Variety Extravaganza
videos.overview: The crowned queens give 'til it hurts, as they star in a charity talent show extravaganza! But first, they each join RuPaul and Michelle Visage for an intimate tic-tac chit-chat! Super-hot actress and comedian Hannah Einbinder joins the judges' panel.

videos.title: Lip Sync LaLaPaRuza
videos.overview: It's a lip sync battle royale, as the crowned queens take the stage for the most epic Lip Sync LalaPaRuza in Drag Race herstory. And in the end, one legend will be crowned Queen of All Queens.

videos.title: The Fame Games
videos.overview: Twelve Drag Race All Stars return for a second chance at the crown and a cash prize of $200,000. And this season, there are two ways to win! After a sickening fashion show mini-challenge, the queens thrill iconic guest judge Idina Menzel.

videos.title: It's RDR Live!
videos.overview: “Live from Tuckahoe... it’s RDR Live!” The All Stars are challenged to serve up laughs in a hilarious Drag Race send-up of the iconic sketch comedy show. SNL alum Bobby Moynihan and special guest judge Robin Thede lend their comedic expertise.

videos.title: The Supermarket Ball
videos.overview: The All Stars storm the runway – and the grocery aisle – transforming everyday supermarket items into supermodel-worthy fashions! Guest judge Jojo Siwa is having a ball as she checks out the parade of 30 gagworthy garments.

videos.title: Screen Queens
videos.overview: The Golden Age of Television gets even sparklier, as the All Stars create and star in their own sickening scripted TV series trailers, directed by Emmy® Award winner Michelle Visage. Euphoria actress Maude Apatow helps decide which trailer is “must-she TV.”

videos.title: Snatch Game of Love
videos.overview: Love is in the air as the queens serve up their flirtiest celebrity impersonations for guest judges Bowen Yang and Matt Rogers in the romantic and raucous “Snatch Game of Love.” But, before the queens hit the runway, the Werkroom is rocked by a game-changing shocker.

videos.title: JOAN: The Unauthorized Rusical
videos.overview: The All Stars channel Hollywood royalty, singing and dancing in “JOAN: The Unauthorized Rusical,” celebrating “Mommie Dearest” herself, Joan Crawford! Then, from one legend to another... On the Runway, category is “Night of 1,000 Grace Joneses.” Choreographer and director Adam Shankman coaches the queens and joins the judges’ panel.

videos.title: Forensic Queens
videos.overview: The Queens’ improv talents are on full display, as they star in a twisted true-crime show, examining the mystery, “Wha-Ha-Happened to Lil’ Poundcake.”

videos.title: You're a Winner Baby!
videos.overview: RuPaul challenges the queens to create looks worthy of the Drag Race Hall of Fame, inspired by past All Stars champions. Drag Race legends Raven and Shannel bring some style guidance to the workroom.

videos.title: Carson Kressley, This is Your Gay Life
videos.overview: The All Stars heat things up to roast beloved judge Carson Kressley in front of a live audience, including a very extra-special surprise guest queen & judge! Michelle Visage and comedian Alec Mapa coach the queens.

videos.title: The Letter "L"
videos.overview: Celebrating the L in LGBTQIA+ , the queens share the miracle of drag with new lesbian sisters, transforming the fabulous queer women into fabulous drag queens.

videos.title: The Fame Games Variety Extravaganza
videos.overview: They’re back! The eliminated queens return to the workroom and read each other to filth before showing off their charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent one last time in the Fame Games Variety Extravaganza. Comedian Ego Nwodim joins the judges’ panel.

videos.title: Grand Finale
videos.overview: The time has come… to crown two queens! First, Ru will announce who fans voted “Queen of the Fame Games!” Then, our finalists will battle for a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame!

videos.title: Drag Queens Save The World
videos.overview: Eight All Stars return to compete to win $200,000 for their favorite charity, and a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. They serve up an epic performance of the anthem "Drag Queens Save the World," and Keke Palmer joins for this gagworthy premiere.

videos.title: The Paint Ball
videos.overview: The Queens present a total of 24 iconic looks on the runway - including hand-painted masterpieces created in the Werk Room - in the art-inspired Paint Ball. Oscar-nominated actor Stephanie Hsu joins the judges' panel to appraise the Queens' work.

videos.title: Snatch Game of Love
videos.overview: Romance is in the air as the Queens impersonate celebrities in the Snatch Game of Love. But when two All Stars want to play the same celeb, things get spicy! Meanwhile, a twist means that more badges are up for grabs! Pop superstar Anitta stops by.

videos.title: Smokin' Hot Firefighter Makeover
videos.overview: This week begins with fiery accusations, and when the Queens are tasked with transforming four sexy firefighters into hot pop stars, things really start to sizzle! Country music duo the Brothers Osborne join the judges panel and feel the heat.

videos.title: Property Queens
videos.overview: This week our All Stars' put their sales skills to the test, as they create raucous real estate commercials for some preposterous properties. Superstar Realtor Tracy Tutor and Comedian Alec Mapa stop by to assess what's on the market.

videos.title: The National Drag Convention Roast
videos.overview: While the ruby snippers cause icy vibes in the workroom, it’s hotter than an oven on the main stage, as the queens roast each other to a crisp. Television icon Ruta Lee joins the panel to witness the hilarious jabs.

videos.title: Meeting In The Ladies Room
videos.overview: This week, the All-Stars get slap happy as they costar with RuPaul in an acting challenge inspired by some of cinema’s most classic catfights. Foxy actor Colton Haynes joins the judging panel to take in all the drama!

videos.title: Make Your Own Kind Of Rusic
videos.overview: After hard feelings rock the workroom, Mama Ru challenges the dolls to create chart-topping looks inspired by her hit songs. Fashion icon Jeremy Scott joins the judge panel to decide which looks are bops and which are flops!

videos.title: Rosemarie's Baby Shower: The Rusical
videos.overview: This week, the All Stars dance with the devil in a spooky-ooky Rusical that leaves the judges shook! Dance music legend Kristine W joins the panel for a twisted good time.

videos.title: Lip Sync LaLaPaRuza Smackdown
videos.overview: The competition is closer than ever, so when Ru announces that the Queens must Lip Sync for their badges this week, the All Stars go into Assassin mode to slay the stage! Who will be the last Queen standing?

videos.title: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 1
videos.overview: This week, Mama Ru drops a gag-worthy twist on the All-Stars... Before their final challenge of the season, the queens must cast a game-changing vote - and it's anybody’s crown to win!

videos.title: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 2
videos.overview: It's the crowning moment of the two-part Grand Finale, and all the Queens hit the stage for an unforgettable Variety Extravaganza! Three badges are up for grabs, and a new voting twist could change everything! In the end, only one queen can win.

videos.title: Winner Winner, Chicken Dinner
videos.overview: The Tournament of All Stars kicks off with the first of three brackets! For this premiere challenge, the 6 Queens of Bracket 1 deliver head-banging heavy metal realness in an 80s-inspired music video.

videos.title: Murder On The Dance Floor
videos.overview: It's Week 2 of the first bracket, and the queens must make the judges drop dead with their improv performances in the whodunit, "Murder on the Dance Floor." Emmy award winning actor and red carpet darling, Colman Domingo, guest judges.

videos.title: Hoop Queens Makeover
videos.overview: It's a buzzer beater to the Semi Finals for this first bracket of queens as they scramble to makeover collegiate basketball players. Meanwhile, the MVQ point system has the dolls calling, "foul," on their sisters. Kate Beckinsale joins the judges panel.

videos.title: Eight Ball
videos.overview: A new bracket of queens arrive in the werkroom where lines are drawn in the sand between competitors. A special delivery from Ru has queens creating dope looks from items found in giant 8-balls. Nightlife icon, Susanne Bartsch, returns to turn the party.

videos.title: Rappin' Roast
videos.overview: After a gaggy MVQ Points Ceremony, the queens are ready to create the ultimate diss track and battle each other in a Rappin' Roast. Supernova superstar Chappell Roan stops by to get a taste of the hot and spicy bars.

videos.title: Starrbooty: The Rebooty
videos.overview: With the semi-finals at stake, it's heroes versus villains, as the queens funk it up for a dyn-o-mite performance of the movie rusical, "Starrbooty: The Rebooty." Legendary producer and director, Adam Shankman, choreographs and guest judges.

videos.title: Wicked Good
videos.overview: The final bracket of 6 queens descend onto the Main Stage to stake their claim for the Drag Race Hall of Fame. Working in teams the queens must create good and wicked witch looks for the runway. Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo enchant on the judges panel.

videos.title: Stagecooch
videos.overview: Coached by country superstar, Orville Peck, the queens divide into dueling country trios to perform honky tonk anthems at the first annual Stagecooch Festival. Drag Race choreographer extraordinaire Jamal Sims returns to the judges panel.

videos.title: The Golden Bitchelor
videos.overview: Things get real after a tense MVQ Points Ceremony. With 3 semi-final spots up for grabs, the queens vie for love and laughs in "The Golden Bitchelor" with "Fire Island" star Zane Phillips. Sitcom pro Mayan Lopez returns to help decide who will move on.

videos.title: Tournament of All Stars Snatch Game
videos.overview: The divine 9 Semi-Finalists return, and Mama Ru cranks up the heat by challenging them to serve their best celeb impersonations in the Snatch Game! Sarah Michelle Gellar slays the judges panel - and one All Star is sent home.

videos.title: Tournament of All Stars Talent Invitational
videos.overview: The 8 Semi-Finalists showcase their most gag-worthy talents in hopes of earning a spot in the finale. Superstar actress Devery Jacobs joins the judges- and one All Star is sent packing.

videos.title: Tournament of All Stars Smackdown for the Crown
videos.overview: One All Star returns to the competition, and everything is on the line as the final 8 Queens lip sync for the crown! Which Queen will snatch victory and be the newest face in the Drag Race Hall of Fame?

videos.title: Break Dancin' 2: Electric Rugaloo
videos.overview: The Tournament of All Stars kicks off as six queens from Bracket 1 break it down in an electrifying ‘80s-inspired performance. Guest judge La Toya Jackson is back – and the queens pay tribute in a dazzling “La Toyas R Us” runway.

videos.title: Bar Queen Couture
videos.overview: Tensions rise following the first MVQ Ceremony - and the queens are challenged to turn queer nightlife into couture using materials inspired by iconic gay bars. Oscar-nominated actress Kate Hudson joins the judges for this high-stakes runway showdown.

videos.title: Shop Til U Drop
videos.overview: With the scoreboard scrambled, the Bracket 1 queens transform into creatures of the night to pitch products on the Home Spooky Network. It’s their last chance to advance to the Semi-Finals - and their final MVQ ceremony - under the gaze of guest judge Christina Ricci.

videos.title: Duets: It Takes Two
videos.overview: Six new queens enter for Bracket 2 — and pair up to perform duets at the Sha-Blammy Awards. But will these musical matches make harmony or total chaos? Broadway star and pop icon Reneé Rapp joins the judges for this vocal showdown.

videos.title: How-To Videos
videos.overview: It’s DIY drag as the queens direct their own over-the-top How-To videos. But with tensions simmering and alliances in flux, this challenge could get messy. Gina Gershon brings her signature smolder to the judges panel.

videos.title: Too Many Daddies
videos.overview: For the final Bracket 2 challenge, the queens make over real-life gay dads. But family ties get tested and shocking twists await in the MVQ Ceremony. Abbott Elementary’s Janelle James lends her wit to the panel.

videos.title: Athletic Supporter Design Challenge
videos.overview: Bracket 3 begins as six new queens turn jockwear into glamazonian eleganza in a sporty design challenge. Who’ll score on the runway? Guest judge Juno Temple brings her British charm - and sharp critiques - to the judges panel.

videos.title: Rappin' Roast Redux
videos.overview: Feelings get fried as the Bracket 3 queens spit spicy verses in a raucous Rappin’ Roast. With shade flying and reps on the line, actor Brian Tyree Henry joins the judges panel to help decide who flowed and who flopped.

videos.title: That's What She Said
videos.overview: For the first time in Drag Race herstory, the queens lip sync to classic ‘90s interviews from The RuPaul Show. With the semifinals in sight, the MVQ ceremony serves up drama as The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City star Bronwyn Newport joins the judges panel.

videos.title: Tell Me Something Good
videos.overview: The Semifinalists return to face off – and the wildcard winner gags the Werkroom. Their first challenge: slay the “Tell Me Something Good” Story Hour, coached by guest judge, comedian Evan Mulrooney. But, a surprising twist leads to a startling elimination.

videos.title: Tournament of All Stars Talent Rumble
videos.overview: The top 7 queens put it all on the line in a no-holds-barred Tournament of All Stars Talent Rumble. With spots in the finale at stake, expect showstoppers, stunts, and surprises. Guest judge Cooper Koch helps decide whose star power reigns supreme.

videos.title: Disco Smackdown For The Crown
videos.overview: It all comes down to this! The final 6 All Stars go head-to-head and toe-to-toe in a Disco Smackdown! But only one queen will claim victory, a $200,000 cash prize, and the coveted spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame!

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 3 wins & 10 nominations total
